axes.model_access: MiniMax's self-developed H series — the official site page on the day shows the version narrative "MiniMax H3 officially launched" / "Hailuo Agent H3 officially launched"; the chat product does not open model picking, and the concrete tiers are only visible after login (not verified logged in).
axes.runtime: Web (hailuoai.com, chat entry at /chat) + App; generation runs on MiniMax's cloud, nothing runs locally. The same vendor also has a developer API line (minimax.io, see the MiniMax Audio entry) and a separate video domain (hailuoai.video, see the Hailuo Video entry).
axes.local_files: Chats and creation assets are stored on the account side (the official nav has an "assets" surface); no locally-held data surface declared by the vendor was found.
axes.background: Chat returns instantly; no official statement verified for an async-task form. Queueing/resume behavior on the video/image generation lines not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The official nav on the day shows Design/assets/tools/video/image/audio multimodal creation surfaces; in-chat tools like web search not verified item by item. No MCP support verified in official statements.
axes.context: Chats organized per conversation; creation assets (video/image/audio) are managed centrally in the account-side "Assets" area and connect with the chat-creation flow. Single-session context-window length and cross-session memory mechanism have no verified official statement (say unknown when unknown).
axes.permissions: Account system (login required); training-usage toggle path not verified item by item. Model-layer filing number in the cn block (cross-verified on the Bailian disclosure page same day).
axes.fit: Fits: a domestic multimodal creation entry combining video+image+audio+chat (MiniMax ecosystem), direct access from the mainland. Not a fit: picking models, running models locally, leaving the MiniMax account.
